# Configuration reference

Every setting `untaped` reads, generated from the settings models. Profile
settings live under `<section>` in `~/.untaped/config.yml` (a named profile's
under `profiles.<name>.<section>`);
state lives in each plugin's own `~/.untaped/plugins/<plugin>/state.yml`
and is written only by that plugin's commands. See
[Configuration](../configuration.md) for the file layout, profiles and
precedence.

Set a profile setting with `untaped config set KEY VALUE` (a token:
`untaped auth login SECTION`; how values are parsed is in
[Settings](../configuration.md#settings)). Each profile setting can be
overridden for one process with the environment variable shown.

## `untaped`

| Key | Type | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `untaped.http.ca_bundle_path` | path (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_UNTAPED__HTTP__CA_BUNDLE_PATH` | PEM file of extra CA certificates to trust instead of the OS trust store. |
| `untaped.http.timeout_seconds` | number | `30.0` | `UNTAPED_UNTAPED__HTTP__TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | HTTP request timeout in seconds. Above 0. |
| `untaped.http.proxy` | string (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_UNTAPED__HTTP__PROXY` | Proxy URL for HTTP clients, and for Git fetches over HTTPS. When unset, standard proxy variables (and, for Git, your Git config) apply. |
| `untaped.ui.theme` | string | `default` | `UNTAPED_UNTAPED__UI__THEME` | Built-in theme. One of: `default`, `plain`, `compact`, `high-contrast`, `quiet`, `classic`. |
| `untaped.ui.format` | `json` \| `yaml` \| `table` \| `raw` \| `pipe` (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_UNTAPED__UI__FORMAT` | Default `--format` for commands whose default is `table`. `UNTAPED_FORMAT` wins over it; an explicit `--format` wins over both. |
| `untaped.ui.border` | `rounded` \| `square` \| `ascii` \| `none` (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_UNTAPED__UI__BORDER` | Table border style; overrides the theme. |
| `untaped.ui.density` | `normal` \| `compact` (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_UNTAPED__UI__DENSITY` | Table density; overrides the theme. |
| `untaped.ui.collection_view` | `table` \| `list` (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_UNTAPED__UI__COLLECTION_VIEW` | How lists render in `table` format; overrides the theme. |
| `untaped.ui.detail_view` | `list` \| `table` (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_UNTAPED__UI__DETAIL_VIEW` | How a single record renders in `table` format; overrides the theme. |
| `untaped.ui.hide_empty_columns` | boolean (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_UNTAPED__UI__HIDE_EMPTY_COLUMNS` | Leave out `table` columns that are empty on every row (on unless the theme turns it off); a column named in `--columns` always shows. |
| `untaped.ui.symbols` | mapping | empty | `UNTAPED_UNTAPED__UI__SYMBOLS` | Symbol overrides merged over the theme's symbols. Names: `success`, `warning`, `error`, `info`, `chosen`, `checked`, `unchecked`, `on`, `off`, `expand`, `collapse`, `mask`, `ellipsis`, `separator`, `cycle.left`, `cycle.right`, `tab.active`, `tab.inactive`, `tree.open`, `tree.closed`, `tag.add`, `tag.remove`, `heading`, `dash`. |
| `untaped.ui.color_roles` | mapping | empty | `UNTAPED_UNTAPED__UI__COLOR_ROLES` | Color-role overrides merged over the theme's colors. Names: `header`, `border`, `key`, `value`, `success`, `info`, `warning`, `error`, `screen.accent`, `screen.muted`, `screen.highlight`, `screen.focus`, `screen.border`, `screen.value`, `screen.success`, `screen.error`, `screen.caret`, `screen.emphasis`, `screen.match`. |
| `untaped.skills.updates` | `warn` \| `auto` \| `off` | `auto` | `UNTAPED_UNTAPED__SKILLS__UPDATES` | What each run does about agent skills in your home folder that an older untaped wrote: `auto` (refresh them), `warn` (print a warning), or `off`. Skills inside a project are never changed by a run. |

## `untaped` state

Kept in `~/.untaped/plugins/untaped/state.yml`.

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `untaped.credentials` | list | One stored credential in the index: what it is for and how to read it, never the secret. |

## `ansible`

| Key | Type | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ansible.index_dir` | path (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__INDEX_DIR` | Folder of the SQLite index of refreshed source data, an absolute path; the file in it is `index.v<layout>.sqlite3`, one per layout. Unset: `plugins/ansible/index/` under the untaped home. |
| `ansible.default_source` | string (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__DEFAULT_SOURCE` | Saved source `deps`, `impact`, `find` and `graph` use when no `--source` or inline selector is given. |
| `ansible.ref_scan_default` | `all` \| `default_branch` | `all` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__REF_SCAN_DEFAULT` | Refs a source scans: `all` refs or each repo's default branch. |
| `ansible.source_refresh_backend` | `auto` \| `graphql` \| `git` | `auto` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__SOURCE_REFRESH_BACKEND` | Ref probe backend for source refresh. |
| `ansible.git_fetch_parallel` | integer | `8` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__GIT_FETCH_PARALLEL` | Default `--parallel` of a source refresh. 1 to 32. |
| `ansible.probe_parallel` | integer | `8` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__PROBE_PARALLEL` | Concurrent ref probes during source refresh. 1 to 32. |
| `ansible.source_refresh_repo_batch_size` | integer | `100` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__SOURCE_REFRESH_REPO_BATCH_SIZE` | Repos committed per source refresh batch. 1 or more. |
| `ansible.source_refresh_rate_limit_floor` | integer | `500` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__SOURCE_REFRESH_RATE_LIMIT_FLOOR` | Stop a refresh (resumable) when the GraphQL budget drops below this. 0 or more. |
| `ansible.dependency_paths` | list | `roles/requirements.yml`; `roles/requirements.yaml`; `requirements.yml`; `requirements.yaml`; `meta/requirements.yml`; `meta/requirements.yaml`; `meta/main.yml`; `meta/main.yaml` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__DEPENDENCY_PATHS` | Dependency files scanned in each repo. |
| `ansible.caches.source_data.max_age_seconds` | integer | `86400` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__CACHES__SOURCE_DATA__MAX_AGE_SECONDS` | Seconds source data is served before untaped checks upstream; 0 checks every time. 0 or more. |

## `awx`

| Key | Type | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `awx.server.url` | URL | unset | `UNTAPED_AWX__SERVER__URL` | AWX/AAP URL, for example `https://aap.example.com`. |
| `awx.server.verify_tls` | boolean or path | `true` | `UNTAPED_AWX__SERVER__VERIFY_TLS` | Check the controller's certificate: `true` (untaped's trust), `false`, or a CA file for this server alone. |

| `awx.page_size` | integer | `200` | `UNTAPED_AWX__PAGE_SIZE` | Results requested per AWX API page. Above 0. |
| `awx.test_timeout_seconds` | number | `1800` | `UNTAPED_AWX__TEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Seconds a `test run` case waits before its job is cancelled, unless `--timeout`, the case's `timeout:` or the suite's `defaults.timeout` sets it. Above 0. Experimental: may change in a minor release. |
| `awx.test_parallel` | integer | `4` | `UNTAPED_AWX__TEST_PARALLEL` | Default `test run --parallel`. Above 0. Experimental: may change in a minor release. |
| `awx.caches.resources.max_age_seconds` | integer | `3600` | `UNTAPED_AWX__CACHES__RESOURCES__MAX_AGE_SECONDS` | Seconds controller resources is served before untaped checks upstream; 0 checks every time. 0 or more. |

## `dotfiles`

| Key | Type | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dotfiles.repos_dir` | path (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_DOTFILES__REPOS_DIR` | Where `dotfiles subscribe URL` clones repos (`<repos_dir>/NAME`), an absolute path. Unset: `plugins/dotfiles/clones/` under the home. Experimental: may change in a minor release. |
| `dotfiles.kept_dir` | path (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_DOTFILES__KEPT_DIR` | Where `apply`, `sync` and `remove` keep local files they replace, under `<repo>/<item>/<timestamp>/`; an absolute path. Unset: `plugins/dotfiles/kept/` under the home. Experimental: may change in a minor release. |
| `dotfiles.state_dir` | path (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_DOTFILES__STATE_DIR` | Holds `status.json` and `attention`, the files a prompt segment reads; an absolute path. Unset: `plugins/dotfiles/prompt/` under the home. Experimental: may change in a minor release. |
| `dotfiles.tags` | list | empty | `UNTAPED_DOTFILES__TAGS` | This machine's tags, matched against `only` and `unless` in manifests. Experimental: may change in a minor release. |
| `dotfiles.os` | `macos` \| `linux` \| `windows` (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_DOTFILES__OS` | This machine's OS for `os` filters; detected when unset. Experimental: may change in a minor release. |

## `dotfiles` state

Kept in `~/.untaped/plugins/dotfiles/state.yml`.

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dotfiles.repos` | list | A subscribed repo: where its clone is and which branch it follows. |
| `dotfiles.items` | list | The machine's decision about one item: its policy and the files it skips. |
| `dotfiles.applied` | list | One placed path: what the tool wrote there and from which source. |

## `git`

| Key | Type | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `git.store_dir` | path (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_GIT__STORE_DIR` | Root of the repo store: one shared bare repository per remote, under `<store_dir>/<host>/<path>.git`; an absolute path. Unset: `plugins/git/store/` under the home. |
| `git.untaped_helper_only` | boolean | `false` | `UNTAPED_GIT__UNTAPED_HELPER_ONLY` | In untaped's worktrees, ask only untaped for a host's credentials, instead of your own Git credential helpers first. |

## `github`

| Key | Type | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `github.server.url` | URL | `https://api.github.com/` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__SERVER__URL` | GitHub API URL. GitHub Enterprise Server uses `https://HOST/api/v3`. |
| `github.server.verify_tls` | boolean or path | `true` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__SERVER__VERIFY_TLS` | Check the server's certificate: `true` (untaped's trust), `false`, or a CA file for this server alone. |
| `github.default_org` | string (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__DEFAULT_ORG` | Org scope for `repos list`, `search` (repos, code, issues), `sweep`, `cache sync` and `cache prune` when no scope flag is given. Without it, search uses `@me`. |
| `github.git_protocol` | `https` \| `ssh` | `https` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__GIT_PROTOCOL` | How `sweep`, `cache sync`, workspace and `ansible source refresh` fetch repos on the GitHub host: `https` or `ssh` (`git@HOST:OWNER/NAME.git`, with your own SSH keys). |
| `github.sweep.parallel` | integer | `12` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__SWEEP__PARALLEL` | Default `sweep --parallel` and `cache sync --parallel` Git workers. 1 or more. |
| `github.inventory.orgs` | list | empty | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__INVENTORY__ORGS` | Orgs whose repositories github lists for workspace (repo names, the picker). With no orgs or teams, `github.default_org`. |
| `github.inventory.teams` | list | empty | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__INVENTORY__TEAMS` | Teams (`ORG/SLUG`, or `SLUG` in the one inventory org, else in `github.default_org`) whose repositories github lists for workspace. |
| `github.caches.sweep.max_age_seconds` | integer | `3600` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__CACHES__SWEEP__MAX_AGE_SECONDS` | Seconds repo data is served before untaped checks upstream; 0 checks every time. 0 or more. |

## `workspace`

| Key | Type | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace.workspaces_dir` | path (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_WORKSPACE__WORKSPACES_DIR` | Parent directory of every workspace (`<workspaces_dir>/NAME`); it belongs to one untaped home, which holds its workspaces' locks. An absolute path; unset: `plugins/workspace/checkouts/` under the home. Experimental: may change in a minor release. |
| `workspace.parallel` | integer (optional) | unset | `UNTAPED_WORKSPACE__PARALLEL` | Default workers for `create`/`add`/`run` and for status/archive checks. Unset means `min(8, 2 * CPUs)`; values above `2 * CPUs` are clamped. 1 or more. Experimental: may change in a minor release. |
| `workspace.branch_template` | string | `{name}` | `UNTAPED_WORKSPACE__BRANCH_TEMPLATE` | Branch name for writable repos; `{name}` is the workspace name. Experimental: may change in a minor release. |
| `workspace.caches.repo_source_repos.max_age_seconds` | integer | `21600` | `UNTAPED_WORKSPACE__CACHES__REPO_SOURCE_REPOS__MAX_AGE_SECONDS` | Seconds repos is served before untaped checks upstream; 0 checks every time. 0 or more. Experimental: may change in a minor release. |

## `workspace` state

Kept in `~/.untaped/plugins/workspace/state.yml`.

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `workspace.workspaces` | list | An active workspace as the plugin's state keeps it, one row per name. |
| `workspace.archived` | list | An archived workspace: its worktrees are gone, its record stays. |

## Renamed settings

A renamed key is still read with a warning; a retired one is no longer read; a deleted one is no longer read and `config migrate` removes it. See [Renamed settings](../configuration.md#renamed-settings).

| Old key | Old environment variable | New key | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ansible.git_fetch_concurrency` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__GIT_FETCH_CONCURRENCY` | `ansible.git_fetch_parallel` | retired |
| `ansible.probe_concurrency` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__PROBE_CONCURRENCY` | `ansible.probe_parallel` | retired |
| `ansible.cache_dir` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__CACHE_DIR` | none | deleted in 11.0; the repo store lives under git.store_dir |
| `ansible.git_blob_filter` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__GIT_BLOB_FILTER` | none | deleted in 11.0; the repo store is blobless |
| `ansible.git_clone_protocol` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__GIT_CLONE_PROTOCOL` | none | deleted in 11.0; set github.git_protocol: ssh to keep ssh |
| `ansible.git_fetch_depth` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__GIT_FETCH_DEPTH` | none | deleted in 11.0; the repo store fetches full history |
| `ansible.index_path` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__INDEX_PATH` | none | deleted in 12.0; ansible.index_dir names the folder that holds the index |
| `ansible.repo_cache_path` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__REPO_CACHE_PATH` | none | deleted in 11.0 (via cache_dir); the repo store lives under git.store_dir |
| `ansible.stale_after` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__STALE_AFTER` | none | deleted in 11.0; use ansible.caches.source_data.max_age_seconds |
| `ansible.stale_after_seconds` | `UNTAPED_ANSIBLE__STALE_AFTER_SECONDS` | none | deleted in 12.0; use ansible.caches.source_data.max_age_seconds |
| `awx.base_url` | `UNTAPED_AWX__BASE_URL` | `awx.server.url` | retired |
| `awx.test_timeout` | `UNTAPED_AWX__TEST_TIMEOUT` | `awx.test_timeout_seconds` | retired |
| `github.base_url` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__BASE_URL` | `github.server.url` | retired |
| `github.sweep.sync_concurrency` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__SWEEP__SYNC_CONCURRENCY` | `github.sweep.parallel` | retired |
| `github.cache_dir` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__CACHE_DIR` | none | deleted in 11.0; the repo store lives under git.store_dir |
| `github.corpus_path` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__CORPUS_PATH` | none | deleted in 11.0 (via cache_dir); the repo store lives under git.store_dir |
| `github.inventory.max_age_seconds` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__INVENTORY__MAX_AGE_SECONDS` | none | deleted in 11.0; workspace keeps the repos github lists for workspace.caches.repo_source_repos.max_age_seconds, 6 hours by default (ctrl-r in its picker refreshes them) |
| `github.inventory.path` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__INVENTORY__PATH` | none | deleted in 11.0; workspace keeps the repos github lists for workspace.caches.repo_source_repos.max_age_seconds, 6 hours by default (ctrl-r in its picker refreshes them) |
| `github.sweep.max_age_seconds` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__SWEEP__MAX_AGE_SECONDS` | none | deleted in 12.0; use github.caches.sweep.max_age_seconds |
| `github.token` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__TOKEN` | none | deleted in 12.0; store the token with `untaped auth login github` |
| `github.token_command` | `UNTAPED_GITHUB__TOKEN_COMMAND` | none | deleted in 12.0; store the token with `untaped auth login github` |
